title: Interactive Claude/Codex/Gemini transcripts no longer indexed — provider-removal deleted their transcript adapters, registry-only pipeline indexes nothing for them
wanted_capability: Indexing of the host's interactive Claude Code / Codex / Gemini session transcripts into the tantivy corpus. fef32d2 (2026-06-02, "Restrict dispatch to bro-harness providers") deleted ClaudeTranscriptAdapter/CodexTranscriptAdapter/opencode (~2,548 lines) as part of the beta provider-removal arc (thread-36035d25), leaving TranscriptAdapterRegistry::from_reindex_config with zero adapters; the reindex transcript phase (index_transcripts_via_adapters, src/index/reindex.rs:285) is now adapter-registry-only, so NO provider transcripts were indexed between June 2 and June 10 (every pass logged transcript phase indexed_files=0). The regression went live in prod with the 2026-06-10 w8 redeploy. Removing Claude/Codex as DISPATCH providers was the arc's intent, but the host's interactive sessions still accumulate (~/.claude/projects, ~/.codex/sessions) and transcript search across them is blackbox's core function — bbox_search/bbox_cite now silently miss everything after June 2 (latest indexed codex docs are June 5, indexed by the pre-cutover prod binary). Aggravating: scan_source_files (reindex.rs:130) still STATs the claude/codex roots for change detection, so constantly-changing interactive transcripts trigger a reindex pass every tick that indexes nothing from them but holds the writer lock through the ~40-minute project phase. Wanted: transcript adapters for claude/codex(/gemini) roots reimplemented against the registry contract (the harness-sessions adapter, src/transcripts/harness_sessions.rs, is now a working reference), or an explicit operator decision that interactive-transcript indexing is out of scope for the v2 beta — in which case the roots should also leave the needs_reindex scan set.
missing_primitive: TranscriptReadAdapter implementations for claude/codex/gemini interactive session roots (registry has only harness-session adapters)
fallback_used: bbox_messages/bbox_session still read live files directly via roots lookup (search.rs), so explicit-session reads work; only index-backed search/cite/recency surfaces are stale.
evidence: thread-36035d25 note 1 (arc scope: remove dispatch providers)
suggested_owner: indexing agent (tmux default-socket session 5, wave-9 IndexWriterActor owner)
notes: OWNERSHIP (operator, 2026-06-10): the indexing-side agent (tmux default socket session 5, owner of the wave-9 IndexWriterActor work on beta) has taken on historical/interactive transcript indexing, including this gap. The w8 agent (session 10) stands down on it; coordination context delivered to session 5 via tmux brief at ~17:15Z. Adapter reference implementation: src/transcripts/harness_sessions.rs (44a3bef).
resolution_note: Interactive Claude/Codex/Gemini adapters restored on beta (8cf46ed) and deployed 2026-06-10 ~18:15Z. Design: TranscriptSource { Harness(Provider) | Claude | Codex | Gemini } decouples transcript identity from dispatch Provider (no dispatch variants resurrected; serde wire-compatible with old label strings/field names). Adapters ported from fef32d2^ into src/transcripts/interactive.rs against the registry contract; all source roots explicit in ReindexConfig (gemini_tmp_root joins harness_sessions_dir's hermetic-by-default contract); from_runtime_config stays harness-only. Companion fixes shipped in the same restart: BufWriter on edge/snapshot writes (613dca2 — pre-fix project phase 58.7min for 41 files, post-fix 27.8s for 16) and the w8 agent's purge-scan fix (7bd118f). LIVE EVIDENCE: first post-deploy pass indexed 604 transcript files / 76,625 docs in ~5min (June 2–10 interactive backfill), purged 0; bbox_search returns hits from a 2026-06-10 15:34Z interactive Claude session (account=claude). needs_reindex churn from live interactive sessions is productive again.
